headline: Zuckerberg Reaches Deal to Keep Meta in California Amid Proposed Tax Concerns
summary: Meta Chief Executive Mark Zuckerberg negotiated an agreement to keep the company based in California, highlighting business sector concerns over a pending state tax proposal.
why: Meta Platforms is one of the world's largest digital advertising and technology companies, maintaining significant economic and employment footprints in California.

impacts.name: Meta Platforms
impacts.why: Tax negotiations resolve immediate relocation uncertainty but long-term regulatory costs depend on final terms.
